description: A profiler for Apple MLX on Apple silicon: measures every operation's GPU time and waiting per stream from Metal's own timestamps, writes an interactive HTML report and JSON, and gives a noise-aware verdict on whether one implementation is faster. C API, usable from C, C++ and Rust.
rules: Pass the MLX location as the CMake cache variable -DMLX_PREFIX=<prefix holding MLX and MLX-C, release 0.32.4 or 0.32.5>; it is never read from the environment, and the final binary must link that one MLX only.

The build_graph callback must append the outputs of a fresh, unevaluated MLX graph on every call; the profiler calls it 11 times for one profile and evaluates each graph itself. Evaluate inputs once outside the callback and pass them in builder_payload.
Every mlx_perf_* function that measures returns 0 on success. On non-zero, read mlx_perf_last_error() before the next mlx_perf_* call on the same thread; the library never throws into the caller.
To decide whether one implementation is faster, call mlx_perf_compare_to_report with both variants. Never compare durations from two separate profiles: they drift and are order-biased.

To compare code that evaluates many graphs (a token loop, a sampler), call mlx_perf_compare_procedures_to_report: run is timed whole; prepare runs untimed before each run. gpu_idle_us and blocking waits show host-GPU hand-off cost.
A verdict of MLX_PERF_VERDICT_WITHIN_SPREAD ("within_spread" in JSON) means the difference did not beat run-to-run noise: report no difference found, never slightly faster or slower.
In the measurement JSON, null means not measured (a CPU-stream node, or a node timed as part of its stage), never zero. Check schema_version is 1, and look fields up by name.
Quote job_wall_median_us as the job's duration. timeline_wall_us is the instrumented pass and is longer by design.
Call mlx_perf_set_console_output(0) to stop the library printing when it runs inside tests, tools or other programs; failures still come back as return codes.
Comparison variant names become file names: non-empty, no '/', and distinct from each other ignoring case. Both variants must produce the same number of outputs with the same shapes and dtypes.
Enable C++ in a C consumer's CMake project (LANGUAGES C CXX) and link mlx_perf::mlx_perf; the library is C++ inside. Requires macOS on Apple silicon with MLX's Metal backend.

To find why a kernel is slow, read kernel_dispatches[] in the measurement JSON: can_fill_gpu false (gpu_core_coverage below 1) means fewer threadgroups than GPU cores, so cores sat idle. Coverage 1 does not prove the launch efficient.

Apple silicon GPU memory is wired; macOS un-wires released memory ~0.2 s late and held memory after ~1 s idle. Read mlx_perf_read_wired_memory; treat wired_outside_mlx_bytes as unreliable just after a release.
